statBlock.name: Manticore
statBlock.description: A winged hunter with a lionlike body and a barbed tail. It ambushes travelers from the air, but a better meal can persuade it to bargain.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks. Choose Rend or Tail Spike for each attack.
Rend. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.
Tail Spike. Ranged attack, +5 to hit, range 100/200 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.
sections.Habitats: Arctic, coasts, grasslands, hills, and mountains.

statBlock.name: Pseudodragon
statBlock.description: A cat-sized dragon that stashes shiny objects in little lairs among trees or rocks. It may befriend a spellcaster, especially one who brings treats.

sections.Languages: understands Common and Draconic but can't speak.
sections.Traits: Magic Resistance. The pseudodragon rolls saving throws against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Bite attacks.
Bite. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
Sting. One visible creature within 5 ft. makes a DC 12 Constitution save. On a failure it takes 5 (2d4) poison damage and becomes Poisoned for 1 hour. While Poisoned this way it is also Unconscious. That Unconscious condition ends early if the creature takes damage or someone within 5 ft. of it uses an action to wake it.
sections.Habitats: Coasts, deserts, forests, hills, mountains, and urban areas.

statBlock.name: Sprite
statBlock.description: A winged, foot-tall defender of enchanted forests. Sprites welcome friendly visitors and ambush those who threaten their home.

sections.Actions:
Needle Sword. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage.
Enchanting Bow. Ranged attack, +6 to hit, range 40/160 ft. On a hit, the target takes 1 piercing damage and is Charmed until the sprite starts its next turn.
Heart Sight. One creature the sprite can see within 5 ft. makes a DC 10 Charisma save. Celestials, Fiends, and Undead fail automatically. On failure the sprite learns the target's emotions and alignment.
Invisibility. The sprite casts Invisibility on itself using Charisma. The spell requires no components.

statBlock.name: Troll
statBlock.description: A predator that drags smaller creatures back to its lair. Its wounds close quickly, and limbs that come off can keep fighting.

sections.Traits:
Loathsome Limbs (4/day). Check at the end of any turn. If the troll is Bloodied and took at least 15 slashing damage during that turn, one of its limbs falls into its space as a Troll Limb. The limb takes its turn immediately after the troll. Each missing limb gives the troll one level of Exhaustion. The next time it regains hit points, it regrows the missing limbs.
Regeneration. The troll heals 15 HP when it starts a turn. Acid or fire damage shuts off this healing on its next turn. The troll can die only if it begins a turn at 0 HP and fails to regenerate.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Rend attacks.
Rend. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Charge. Move up to half the troll's speed straight toward an enemy it can see.
sections.Habitats: Arctic, forests, hills, mountains, swamps, and the Underdark.

statBlock.name: Umber Hulk
statBlock.description: An armored burrower that tracks movement through stone. It digs beside traveled passages and punches through the wall to ambush prey.

sections.Traits: Tunneler. The umber hulk burrows through solid rock at half its burrow speed and leaves a tunnel 10 ft. across.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Rend attacks.
Rend. Melee attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.
sections.Bonus actions:
Confusing Gaze (recharge 5–6). Every creature in a 30-ft. cone makes a DC 14 Wisdom save. A creature that fails loses its reactions until the umber hulk starts its next turn and rolls 1d8 to determine what it does on its own next turn.
1–4. Do nothing.
5–6. Take neither an action nor a bonus action. Spend all movement going in a random direction.
7–8. Make a melee attack against a creature chosen at random from those within reach. Do nothing if no such attack is possible.
